programs.description: As a powerful crime lord threatens New York City, a team of mutant turtles trained in martial arts tries to leave their hidden lair to defend their beloved home from impending danger.
Thomas's mundane and depressing life as a video game developer ends when a group of rebels frees him from his world, which turns out to be a new version of the Matrix.
Courtney Collins, a single mother, relocates to a rural home with her twin sons. Later, she discovers it's inhabited by malevolent spirits connected to the sinister entity Bughuul.
The host invites prominent personalities and engages them in candid conversations about their personal and professional lives.
A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.

A prosecutor commits a fatal hit-and-run, then manipulates the case so that the man who was arrested for the crime is acquitted. After the trial, he discovers that his actions have freed a guilty man.

John Wick uncovers a path to defeating The High Table. But before he can earn his freedom, Wick must face off against a new enemy with powerful alliances across the globe and forces that turn old friends into foes.
Thomas's mundane and depressing life as a video game developer ends when a group of rebels frees him from his world, which turns out to be a new version of the Matrix.
With the kingdom in need of a ruler after King Harold's death, Shrek embarks on a quest to find Arthur, Fiona's cousin, while Prince Charming plans to seize control of the throne.
As a powerful crime lord threatens New York City, a team of mutant turtles trained in martial arts tries to leave their hidden lair to defend their beloved home from impending danger.
An aspiring gangster pretends to be part of a notorious gang and tries to terrorise a neighbourhood. However, unknown to him, three martial arts experts live there and are ready to take him down.
Paul, the young scion of House Atreides, faces troubling visions of the future. Meanwhile, his family fights to gain control over Arrakis, the only source of the valuable spice melange.
When a hacker reveals the identities of Britain's undercover agents, British agent Johnny English springs back into action and must overcome the challenges of modern technology.
A legendary monster named King Ghidorah awakens Rodan, as well as other titans, to destroy the world. To defeat them, the crypto-zoological organisation Monarch must rely on the almighty Godzilla.
A Vietnam War veteran arrives in a small town but faces hostility from the local sheriff, leading to a tense conflict where survival instincts and combat skills take over.

Katniss volunteers to replace her sister in a tournament that ends only when one participant remains. Pitted against contestants who have trained for this all their life, she has little to rely on.
During the Klondike Gold Rush, a lone prospector goes through a series of misfortunes, including a blizzard and starvation. However, he finds love even in the stormy Alaska.
In a deadly game orchestrated by President Snowballs, skilled archer Kantmiss Evershot, her lover Dale and tech-savvy ally Peter Malarkey must rely on their wits and skills to survive.
Necross, the former guardian of the sun, turns evil and steals it. Now, Mune, Glim and Sohone, three friends, must work together to retrieve it from him.
Four talented magicians are plucked from obscurity to become the Four Horsemen - a group of stage illusionists who soon attract the attention of the FBI.
After 30 years of service, Maverick mentors a troop of elite Top Gun alumni for an esteemed mission while battling his demons from the past.
A Vietnam War veteran arrives in a small town but faces hostility from the local sheriff, leading to a tense conflict where survival instincts and combat skills take over.
After being granted the divine power of the Egyptian Gods and spending almost 5000 years in a guardhouse, Black Adam is freed and decides to unleash his style of justice on the world.
In 1956 France, Sister Irene faces the terrifying demon Valak, racing against time to save a convent and the surrounding community from evil.
After a crucial operation goes wrong, IMF Agent Ethan Hunt and his team must work together with a few allies to prevent a nuclear attack.

Maximus is a Roman general, loved by the people and the aging Emperor. The Emperor chooses Maximus to be his heir over his own son and a power struggle leaves Maximus and his family condemned to death.
The Decepticons are trying to learn the secrets of a stranded Cybertronian spacecraft. Sam Witwicky and the Autobots must stop them before it is too late.

Detective John Hobbes witnesses the execution of a demonic serial killer, Edgar Reese. However, questions arise when the murders start again, eerily matching the modus operandi of Reese.

After corrupt cops are unable to catch his wife's killers, Stanley, an unemployed man, teams up with an old friend to avenge her death.
Batman and friends try to stop Joker from taking over Gotham city while trying to form a relationship with his adopted ward Dick Grayson, who becomes his sidekick.
After their victory in the 74th Hunger Games, Katniss and Peeta must participate in the 75th Annual Hunger Games, featuring all its previous winners.
Johnny English, a bumbling British agent, teams up with an Interpol agent and attempts to locate a French billionaire who has stolen the crown jewels.
After Set, the Egyptian God of darkness, kills his brother and seizes the throne, he enslaves the kingdom. However, a flawed mortal, Bek, and the God of the sky Horus rise to challenge him.
Optimus Prime seeks his creator in space. Meanwhile, humans and Autobots join forces to save Earth from an ancient threat.
After being abandoned at a fair, Billy constantly searches for his mother. His life, however, takes a huge turn when he inherits superpowers from a powerful wizard.

Loretta Sage, a novelist of ancient tombs and daring quests, faces real-life peril when abducted by an eccentric billionaire seeking a mythical lost city. Meanwhile, Alan, her attractive book cover model, launches a clumsy rescue attempt. Together, they navigate jungle dangers and interpersonal conflicts to unearth the fabled treasure before it vanishes forever.
A gangster, who seeks to retire from the life of crime, faces a threat when an upcoming rival challenges his authority. He then decides to take help from a trustworthy former apprentice.
After losing his job, lover and his powers, Peter Parker feels dissatisfied with his life. Soon, amidst all this chaos, he also has to fight Doctor Octavius who poses a threat to the New York.
Two philanderers get stuck in a situation when one of them falls for the bridesmaid at one of the weddings that they intrude.

An archeology expert joins an Indian professor to look for a lost treasure of India. However, things take a dangerous turn when they are ambushed in their quest.
A bricklayer's plans of having a fun weekend go for a toss when he finds it difficult to reach home during a downpour. When he finally reaches home, he realises that his wife is angry with him.
A menial farmworker falls in love with his neighbour's daughter. He tries hard to convince her father to agree to their marriage.
John Wharton, the captain of an elite task force, raids a safe house owned by one of the most lethal drug cartels with his team. Though the mission is successful, death awaits them.
The Tramp falls in love with a girl with visual impairment who sells flowers on the street. He tries to help her gain her eyesight back with the help of a wealthy man.
When four lifelong friends receive three tickets from singer Paula Abdul to her concert, they compete in a series of pranks to decide which amongst them will attend the show.
A factory production line worker is thrown out on the street for his manic behaviour. He then meets a young, homeless girl, who is recently orphaned, and tries to build a home with her.
When Sam Witwicky buys a car, he unwittingly involves himself in a clash between Autobots and Decepticons over a device that can create life.
Following IMF's assimilation into the CIA, Ethan Hunt and his team face a new challenge from the Syndicate, an international rogue group determined to destroy their organisation.
A group of misfits are coerced to work together for a dangerous mission in Corto Maltese. Despite their differences, they learn to trust each other and collaborate as a team.
Stuck in the middle of the conflict between Dementus and Immortan Joe, Furiosa fights to escape from their clutches and return to her safe haven, the Green Place.
Dylan secretly guides the Horsemen as they reappear with a bold plan, only to be drawn into a tech billionaire's twisted scheme involving a powerful data chip.

While the holiday season represents the most magical time of year, ancient European folklore warns of Krampus, a horned beast who punishes naughty children at Christmastime. When dysfunctional family squabbling causes young Max (Emjay Anthony) to lose his festive spirit, it unleashes the wrath of the fearsome demon. As Krampus lays siege to the Engel home, mom (Toni Collette), pop (Adam Scott), sister (Stefania LaVie Owen) and brother must band together to save one another from a monstrous fate.
